page.layout: One page of text. Above it: a woodcut headpiece. Below that, centred: a dedication title in capitals. Below the title: running text with a woodcut initial P, then two lines of italic verse. At the foot: the signature at left, the catchword at right, and the page number at far right.

main_text.head: CLARISSIMO ADOLESCENTI D°. ROBERTO DORMER Baroni de WING
main_text.p: Patere (Baro Illustrissime) ut sub Tuis prodeat auspiciis, hæc ad Iuniores Concio : Si alicubi pungat, de Apibus agit ; quæ ut abundant melle : ita non carent Aculeo.

p.i: Non quisquā fruitur veris odoribus, Hyblæos latebris nec spoliat favos;

page.notes: The headpiece at the top and the woodcut initial P are decoration, not text, and are not transcribed. "quisquā" has a tilde over the a, read as the abbreviation for quisquam. The J of the signature mark is a decorated form and is read as J; the catchword "Si" is at the right below the last line. The word "Patere" is the woodcut P joined to the printed "atere".
